model_conclusions.reason: One completed pair contributes X in[0,.25,.5,.75,1], with N=pairs and games=2N. True Elo uses logistic score 1/(1+10^(-E/400)); nElo bounds use s(e)=.5+(e/C)*sqrt(2v), C=800/ln10. No logistic/nElo substitution found.

p_i(theta) proportional p_i*exp(theta*x_i); monotone tilted mean is solved for logistic target, zeros remain zero and unreachable support is rejected. Draw model is convolution of[L,D,W] with W=mu-D/2 and L=1-mu-D/2; infeasible probabilities rejected. Updated documentation correctly avoids identifying game WDL/Pearson dependence from pentanomial counts.

The code equals N*(s1-s0)*(2*mean-s0-s1)/(2*v). nElo simplification is sqrt(2)*Delta/C*N*(mean-.5)/sqrt(v) - Delta*(e0+e1)/C^2*N. Empirical population variance is recomputed at every pair. Zero-variance prefixes are unavailable/NaN and cannot cross, rather than fabricated decisions.

The lower-bound image CDF uses x=-lower and width=upper-lower; upper flux correctly reflects x to width-x and drift to -drift. cap=1-H0-H1. Capped mean is twice the integral of survival to cap_pairs; median is cap when survival(cap)>=.5, otherwise the survival=.5 root. Deterministic diffusion limits and a crossing exactly at cap are correct.

For nElo, h=sqrt(2)*Delta/(C*sqrt(v)), drift=h*(mu-.5)-Delta*(e0+e1)/C^2, IF=h*((X-mu)-(mu-.5)*((X-mu)^2-v)/(2v)); diffusion=E(IF^2). Logistic bounds correctly include the variance-estimation derivative. This is asymptotic Gaussian/Brownian advice, not exact Fastchess GSPRT.

Observed Elo minus modeled bias is labelled a plug-in sensitivity; its interval is simulation error, not a corrected observational confidence interval. Nonfinite selected values block the mean and are not discarded. Missing paired profiles and different concurrency cannot be borrowed.
